summary: Verified the React-crash fix for EXPRESSbakēd 'Book Now' 422 handling. All three scenarios PASS on the customer app (/express/book/estimate) at 1440×900. (1) BAD DRAFT (pickup.line1 missing) seeded into sessionStorage → click Book Now → backend returns 422 with Pydantic array; the `api` interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js normalizes `detail` into the string 'pickup.line1: Field required', which is rendered as a sonner toast (top-right). No CRA red overlay, no `pageerror`, header/wizard/footer remain fully mounted. (2) REGRESSION: valid draft → Book Now creates booking exp_eed341b06c0e4335 and auto-redirects to /express/booking/{id}/track showing the LIVE tracking screen. (3) normalizeApiError helper unit-verified in-browser for all 5 shapes (string→string, Pydantic array→dot-joined msg, {msg}→msg, generic obj→JSON, null→null). AdminContext.jsx confirmed to import the same helper and register the identical interceptor on adminApi (visual code review, since triggering an admin 422 was out of scope for a frontend-only e2e verification of the same code path already proven on the customer instance).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor mutates `err.response.data` in place (sets d.detail = string, d.raw_detail = original). This is convenient but not idempotent if another interceptor runs after and re-reads detail. It also mutates the axios error response object shared with any subsequent .catch chains. Fine here since it's the only interceptor, but consider returning a shallow-cloned object to keep the response immutable.

normalizeApiError joins Pydantic messages with ' · ' (middle-dot separator). Multi-error cases will produce a long string that sonner truncates. Consider `toast.error(msgs[0])` for the primary message with the rest under toast.description, or an array-aware toast helper.

The interceptor runs for ALL responses whose body has a `detail` key, not just 422s. That is safe for 400/401/403/404/409/500 too (they all use string detail in FastAPI HTTPException), but if any endpoint intentionally returns a structured detail object (e.g., driver-assignment error with fields), UI code reading err.response.data.detail.<field> will now get a JSON string. Consider gating on Array.isArray(d.detail) so string/object detail passes through untouched.

AdminContext.jsx duplicates the ~10-line interceptor block that lib/api.js already has. Extract into `attachDetailNormalizer(axiosInstance)` in lib/api.js and call it from both places to avoid drift when the shape evolves.

Persisting from iteration_9: Google Maps Directions REQUEST_DENIED still floods the console 4× per Step 2-5 render (legacy API not enabled + unstable onMeta useEffect dep). Not related to this fix but continues to add noise that can hide real errors during future testing.

To reproduce the original crash for regression, remove the interceptor and repeat the bad-draft click-Book-Now flow. Fast path to Step 5 without walking Steps 1-4: seed sessionStorage.baked_express_draft with the payload documented in the review request (with pickup.line1 removed to trigger 422, or kept to get a successful booking).
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE (pre-fix): FastAPI Pydantic V2 returns 422 with `detail` as an ARRAY of {type, loc, msg, input, url} objects. Call-sites did `toast.error(err.response.data.detail || 'Fallback')`, passing the raw array into sonner → sonner rendered it as JSX children → React threw 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})' which surfaced as a CRA red overlay in dev. MITIGATION (this fix): Added `normalizeApiError(detail)` + a response interceptor on both `api` and `adminApi` that replaces `err.response.data.detail` with a rendered string ('<loc>: <msg> · …') while preserving the original at `raw_detail`. Every existing call-site now silently receives a string. VERIFIED on customer app with a real 422; admin app path is code-equivalent (same helper, same interceptor snippet).
